question: Which of the followed compounds is prepared when sodium chloride reacts with carbon dioxide in the presence of ammonia and water?
solution:
The correct answer is **__NaHCO₃__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• sodium chloride reacts with carbon dioxide -**NaCl+ CO₂- NaHCO₃(presence of amonia(NH₃)and water)**
 
• Sodium sulfate (Na₂SO₄) can be formed through the reaction of sodium hydroxide (NaOH) with sulfuric acid (H₂SO₄):**NaOH + H₂SO₄→Na₂SO**₄+ **H₂O**
 
• When Sodium hydroxide reacts with carbon dioxide that resulting Sodium carbonate :2NaOH+CO₂→Na₂CO₃+ H₂O
